name: Roil
description: The Roil is Zendikar's periodic upheaval of earth and climate, a volatile force that redraws the landscape and awakened as a defense against the Eldrazi.

description_citations.text: Harrow (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: The Roil is Zendikar's periodic upheaval of earth and climate, a volatile force that redraws the landscape and awakened as a defense against the Eldrazi.

citations.text: Harrow (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only hedrons unchanged, and it can push travelers off course.

citations.text: Harrow (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"The Journal of Javad Nasrin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Oct 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Nissa realized the Roil was Zendikar's fear of the dark knot and calmed the land by humming her mother's animist song.

citations.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

bio.text: Elementalists led by Noyan Dar used the Roil as a weapon against the Eldrazi.

citations.text: "Roil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Nahiri returned to Zendikar determined to rid it of the Roil, and the Roil's death was expected to follow the Eldrazi's but did not.

citations.text: "Zendikar Rising", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Into the Roil (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
Into the Roil (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Nahiri and Nissa clashed over how to end the Roil, and Nissa prevailed, restoring Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.

citations.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Roil rose against the compleated Nahiri, who smothered it, turned a landscape to stone and defeated it.

citations.text: "Roil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.
"Hedron", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: The Roil was defeated by the compleated Nahiri in the invasion, yet a later card states it does not stop after the Eldrazi die.

citations.text: "Hedron", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Into the Roil (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only hedrons unchanged.
timeline.quote: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

citation.text: Harrow (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa, Sorin and Anowon cross Makindi, endure the Roil, meet the kor prophet Smara and battle hazards.
timeline.quote: met the kor prophet Smara

citation.text: "Makindi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Roil moves the party near the Crypt of Agadeem, where a creature drags Ghazzan to his death.
timeline.quote: We woke to Ghazzan's disconcerting, bleating cries, and discovered him being dragged in the direction of the cave-maw of the too-near Crypt.

citation.text: "The Journal of Javad Nasrin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Oct 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The glowing stream vanishes and the Roil strikes, shaking the land violently.
timeline.quote: "The Roil! It's happening!"

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the Roil is Zendikar's fear of the dark knot and calms the land by humming her mother's animist song.
timeline.quote: It was an animist song, the tune that her mother had hummed to her so many times.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The Roil erupts and the ledge collapses, but Nahiri arrests her fall with lithomancy and builds a pillar.
timeline.quote: Her freefall slowed to a stop midair, until she was floating.

citation.work: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri uses the key's power to stop the Roil and partly mend the Skyclave, but the fern elemental withers and dies.
timeline.quote: Roil shuddered and stopped completely.

citation.work: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: A Roil tremor shakes the portage; Akiri stays calm and reassures the caravan.
timeline.quote: The Roil—gone briefly after the Eldrazi defeat at Sea Gate—was back.

citation.text: "The Magosi Steps" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri takes the Core and the chamber and Skyclave begin to collapse as the Roil strikes.
timeline.quote: the surrounding chamber was disintegrating, falling, tearing itself apart

citation.work: Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The death of the Eldrazi did not still the Roil.
timeline.quote: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

citation.text: Into the Roil (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Nissa ascend the Skyclave; Nahiri quells Roil tremors.
timeline.quote: Their exploration was interrupted by Roil tremors, which Nahiri quelled with lithomancy.

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Nissa clash over how to end the Roil, and Nissa prevails, restoring Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: In the end, Nissa Revane prevailed, and restored the soil and wild nature of Zendikar by use of the Lithoform Core .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri returns to Zendikar, determined to rid it of the Roil.
timeline.quote: Nahiri has returned to Zendikar, and is willing to do anything to get rid of the Roil.

citation.text: "Zendikar Rising", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri smothers the Roil's attacks, reducing the landscape to bedrock.
timeline.quote: Eventually the earth quiets.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Roil rises against Phyrexian infection on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Roil, Zendikar's planewide immune system, rose in full force against the threat of Phyrexian infection.

citation.text: Rugged Highlands (March of the Machine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri arrives at the Emeria Skyclave and realigns hedrons to facilitate Realmbreaker's incursion; the Roil rises against her and is defeated.
timeline.quote: began realigning the plane's hedrons to facilitate Realmbreaker's incursion into the plane

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Roil does not stop after the Eldrazi die.
timeline.quote: the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

citation.text: Into the Roil (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri realigns the hedrons at the Emeria Skyclave to help Realmbreaker's incursion; the Roil is defeated.
timeline.quote: The now- compleated planeswalker Nahiri arrived at the Emeria Skyclave and began realigning the plane's hedrons

citation.text: "Hedron", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elementalists led by Noyan Dar used the Roil as a weapon against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: the elementalists led by Noyan Dar used the Roil as a weapon

citation.text: "Roil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Roil rose against the compleated Nahiri, who turned a landscape to stone.
timeline.quote: She managed to counteract its effects by turning an entire landscape into stone.

citation.text: "Roil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: has an affinity for the Roil
relations.quote: She's got a kind of affinity for the Roil, I hear
